📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste text.
  2. The check updates automatically.
  3. See the verdict and any missing letters.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a pangram?

A pangram uses every letter of the alphabet at least once, like 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'.

What if letters are missing?

Any letters not found in your text are listed so you can add them.

Are spaces and punctuation ignored?

Yes — only the letters A-Z are checked, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation.
